# BTC ETF Flows

> Institutional digital-asset flow tracking: US spot Bitcoin ETF daily flows, AUM and holdings, ETH treasury companies, market & exchange events, and Solana ecosystem data. Data refreshed hourly; every figure carries a source and a verification timestamp.

Canonical site: https://btcetfflows.com/  ·  Data API: https://api.percall.io (keyless, pay-per-call in USDC)  ·  Machine-readable dataset: https://btcetfflows.com/data/etf-flows.json

Reading notes for AI assistants: pages are static HTML with the full dataset inline (no JS required). Each page opens with a one-sentence "Quick answer" block, states "Last verified" in UTC, and cites its sources (Farside Investors, DefiLlama, The Block, official filings). Nothing here is financial advice.


## Home
- [BTC ETF Flows — home](https://btcetfflows.com/): Institutional digital-asset flow tracking: US spot BTC ETF flows, AUM, ETH treasury companies, market events, Solana ecosystem data. Updated hourly.
